html:
Question 11
?

Given that the tangent line approximation to the function f(x) at x=−3 underestimates the values of the function in the neighborhood of x=−3, which of the following must be true?

a
f(x) is concave up in the neighborhood of x=−3
b
f(x) has a local minimum at x=−3
c
f(x) has a local maximum at x=−3
d
f(x) has an inflection point at x=−3
e
f(x) is concave down in the neighborhood of x=−3
Submit
